entries.def:
πολεμέω, -ῶ
(πόλεμος), [in LXX chiefly for לָחַם ni. ;] 
to make war, fight: Rev.12.7 b Rev.19.11 before μετά (2Sa.21.15 and see M, Pr., 106, 247), Rev.2.16; 12.7 a Rev.13.4; 17.14; hyperb., of private quarrels, Jas.4.2.†
(AS)

πόλεμος, -ον, ό 
[in LXX chiefly for מִלְחָמָה ;] 
__1. war: Mat.24.6, Mrk.13.7, Luk.14.31; 21.9, Heb.11.34; π. ποιεῖν, before μετά, with genitive (cf. πολεμέω), Rev.11.7; 12.17; 13.7; 19.19. 
__2. = μάχη, a fight, battle: 1Co.14.8, Rev.9.7, 9; 12.7; 16.14; 20.8; hyperb., of private quarrels (cf. πολεμέω), Jas.4.1.†
(AS)

πόλις, -εως, ὁ, 
[in LXX chiefly and very frequently for עִיר ;] 
a city: Mat.2.23, Mrk.1.45, Luk.4.29, Jhn.4.8, al. mult.; opposite to κῶμαι (κ. καὶ ἀγροί), Mat.9.35; 10.11, Mrk.6.56, Luk.8.1; 13.22; with nom. propr. in appos. (cl.), Act.11.5; 16.14; with id. in genitive appos. (BL, §35, 5), Act.8.5, 2Pe.2.6; genitive, of the region, Luk.1.26; 4.31, Jhn.4.5; of the inhabitants, Mat.10.5, 23 Luk.23.51, Act.19.35,…

πολιτάρχης, -ου, ὁ 
= πολίαρχος (Pind., Eur.), 
the ruler of a city, a politarch: Act.17.6, 8 (see MM, xx).†
(AS)

πολιτεία, -ας, ἡ
(πολιτεύω), [in LXX: 2Ma.4.11 2Mac.6.23 2Mac.8.17 2Mac.13.14, 3Ma.3.21 3Mac.3.23, 4Ma.3.20 4Mac.8.7 4Mac.17.9 * ;] 
__1. citizenship: Act.22.28 (3 Mac, ll. with, Hdt., Xen., a1.). 
__2. government, administration (Aristoph., Dem., al.). 
__3. a commonwealth: Eph.2.12.†
(AS)

πολίτευμα, -τος, τό
(πολιτεύω), [in LXX: 2Ma.12.7 * ;] 
__1. an act of administration. 
__2. a form of government. 
__3. = πολιτεία, 
__(a) citizenship : Php.3.20 (R, txt.); 
__(b) community, commonwealth : Phi, l.with (R, mg.; for exx, see MM, xx).†
(AS)

πολιτεύω more frequently as depon., -ομαι, and so in LXX and NT 
(πολίτης), [in LXX: Est.8.13, 2Ma.6.1 2Mac.11.25, 3Ma.3.4 3Mac.3.1-30; 4Ma.4.1-26 * ;] 
to be a citizen, live as a citizen: metaphorically, of conduct as based on heavenly citizenship, Act.23.1, Php.1.27.†
(AS)

πολίτης, -ου, ὁ
(πόλις), [in LXX chiefly for רֵעַ ;] 
__1. a citizen: with genitive loc., Luk.15.15, Act.21.39. 
__2. a fellow-citizen: with genitive of person(s), Luk.19.14, Heb.8.11" (LXX) .†
(AS)

πολλαπλασίων, -ον
(πόλυς), 
= πολλαπλάσιος, 
many times more: Mat.19.29, Luk.18.30.†
ἑπταπλασίων, -ον, 
genitive, -ονος, 
[in LXX for שִׁבְעָתַיִם, Psa.79.12, al. ;] 
sevenfold: Luk.18.30 (WH, mg., for πολλαπλ- WH, txt., RV; see WH, Notes, 62).†
(AS)
